landing.heroTitle: Track spending. Pace every budget against the month.
landing.heroBody: FundFlow records what you spend and earn, gives each category a monthly limit, and shows whether it’s on track for the days that are left.
landing.heroFrameDescription: A sample month in FundFlow: $2,251.04 spent of $2,400.00 budgeted on day 19 of 30, with Entertainment over budget and Food ahead of pace.
landing.addTitle: Add an expense from any screen
landing.addBody: One dialog, a few fields. Type amounts the way you write them, 12.50 or 12,50, and the right budget updates at once. If it tips a category over, you hear about it straight away.
landing.paceTitle: Budgets that know what day it is
landing.paceBody: Each category gets a monthly limit. The line on its bar marks where spending should be today, so a budget running ahead turns amber long before it turns red. Rent and other fixed bills are only flagged when they go over.
landing.insightsBody: Monthly and yearly reports break spending down by category, compare it with last month and set it against your income, with every chart also readable as a table.
landing.assistantBody: The assistant answers questions like “Which budget is most at risk?” from a summary of your last three months, in your language. Powered by Google Gemini; conversations aren’t saved.
landing.sampleAnswer: Entertainment. You’ve spent {spent} of your {limit} budget with 11 days left, mostly the {ticket} concert tickets. Food is next: {food} of {foodLimit}, a little ahead of pace.
landing.alsoShopping: A shopping list you can check off
landing.closeBody: Creating an account takes a name, an email and a password. You can delete everything from Settings at any time.
landing.footerOrigin: Started as a Northeastern INFO 6150 team project; rebuilt with Next.js, Tailwind and MongoDB.
landing.deleted: Your account and all of its data were deleted.
